DEM DTR_CTL_NO_MIN 0x02 Values are reported, but minimum limit is not available (not valid); lower limit value is ignored. DEM_DTR_CTL_RESET 0x03 Values are all ignored. External representation will be all zeros as initialized (e.g. after fault clear) Range DEM DTR_CTL_INVISIBLE 0x04 Values are all ignored.
